theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (m : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → m (V : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → m K < ∞) → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → m ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = m A) → ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, m = c • (μHE[n]).restrict (V : Set (Euclid P))
